title: Applicability boundaries of NMF detrital-zircon unmixing — reproducibility package
description: Code and data accompanying Pan, L., "Practical identifiability of mixing weights with overlapping known components: a KS-distance criterion and a large-scale Monte Carlo study, with application to detrital-zircon provenance" (manuscript prepared for Computational Statistics). Reproduces the CompStat figures: synthetic data generator; single-axis scan harness; calibration (sigma_err) harness; joint atlas generator; KKT-certified supervised KL solver (Algorithm 2 and floor-free v2 certificate/repair); convergence diagnosis; recomputed single-axis and calibration outputs; certified joint-atlas cell summary from D107 job 269547 (1,541,100 configurations; 1618 observed cells; postprocess COMPLETE; 1 uncertified row in 1 config); plotting scripts; and the real-sample a-priori screen (fifteen Cretaceous / Jurassic–Lower Cretaceous samples). Also retains the archived Algorithm-1 outputs of v1.2.2 for comparison. Code and synthetic results: MIT licence. Real age samples redistributed under original CC BY 4.0 licences (OneDZ Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.15522949; Puetz et al. Figshare 10.6084/m9.figshare.24852987.v1) with per-sample attribution; not re-licensed as MIT. The full per-seed atlas raw (560 MB; 187 MB gzipped) and the certified atlas per-unit JSON dumps (~816 MB) are not included; available from the author on request (size). No separate public archive DOI for those raw dumps was found in the project records searched.
